userStories.title: Add BM25 index build to Pipeline G
userStories.description:
Current state: pipeline_g.py exists at /app/zk-rag-v2/pipeline_g/pipeline_g.py and upserts chunk vectors to Qdrant. No BM25 index exists.

What to build: At the end of each batch run (when --batch finishes processing all eligible docs), Pipeline G should build a BM25 index from all chunk text across all processed collections and save it to /data/military-documents/bm25_index.pkl as a pickle file. On subsequent batch runs, the index should be loaded and updated incrementally (append new docs, do not rebuild from scratch).

BM25 library: rank_bm25.
BM25 index pickle format:
  'bm25': BM25Okapi instance
  'chunk_ids': list of chunk_id strings aligned with BM25 corpus
  'doc_ids': list of doc_id strings (one per chunk)

At end of batch run:
1. Collect all chunk text + chunk_ids + doc_ids from the processed docs this run
2. If /data/military-documents/bm25_index.pkl exists, load it and append new entries to the corpus
3. Rebuild BM25 index with full corpus
4. Pickle to /data/military-documents/bm25_index.pkl

chunk_id format: '{doc_id}-{chunk_index}' (e.g. '0a21e769...-0').
Do NOT rebuild from scratch on every run if index already exists.
Do NOT index text from Pipeline G chunks that were already in a previous batch.
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -m py_compile /app/zk-rag-v2/pipeline_g/pipeline_g.py
python3 -c "import rank_bm25; import pickle; print('rank_bm25 available')"
test -f /data/military-documents/bm25_index.pkl

userStories.title: Add lazy embedding model loader module
userStories.description:
Current state: /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/api_server.py exists with /health and /api/collections. No embedding model is loaded anywhere.

What to build: Create /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/embedding.py with:
- load_embedding_model() -> Callable[[str], numpy.ndarray]
  - Loads sentence_transformers model 'Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B' on first call
  - Returns a sync function that takes a string and returns a 1024-dim numpy array with normalize_embeddings=True
  - Subsequent calls return the already-loaded model (no re-loading)
- Module-level global: _embedding_model = None
- The returned function must be thread-safe

Do NOT use async for the model loading or encode function — keep it synchronous.

userStories.title: Implement POST /api/query — vector search only
userStories.description:
Current state: /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/api_server.py exists with /health and /api/collections. /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/embedding.py exists with load_embedding_model() from US-005.

What to add: POST /api/query with vector-only search (hybrid comes in US-007).

Request body: {query: str, top_k: int (default 5, max 50), collection: str (one of the 6 collections)}

Behaviour:
1. Lazy-load embedding model via load_embedding_model() on first query
2. Embed query text -> 1024-dim numpy vector
3. Search Qdrant: client.query_points(collection=collection, query=vector, limit=top_k, with_payload=True)
4. Return full payload for each result with added 'score' field

Response: {results: [payload objects with 'score' added], query: str, collection: str, total: int}

Collection must be one of the 6 known collections. No '*' wildcard in this story.

Do NOT add BM25 or hybrid search yet. Do NOT add '*' collection support yet.

userStories.title: Add BM25 search and hybrid scoring to /api/query
userStories.description:
Current state: /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/api_server.py exists with POST /api/query vector-only from US-006. No BM25 support exists.

What to add to POST /api/query:

1. Load BM25 index from /data/military-documents/bm25_index.pkl at module level. If file missing, log warning once and set bm25_index = None.

2. New request field: 'hybrid' (bool, default true). If hybrid=false, skip BM25.

3. If hybrid=true and bm25_index is not None:
   a. Run vector search -> ranked list V
   b. Run BM25 search: tokenize query, score all chunks against query, take top 50 -> ranked list B
   c. Merge V and B using RRF formula: score = 0.5 * (1/(60 + vector_rank)) + 0.5 * (1/(60 + bm25_rank))
   d. Return merged top-k results

4. If hybrid=true but bm25_index is None: fall back to vector-only, log one warning.

Do NOT add collection='*' support yet.
acceptanceCriteria: python3 -m py_compile /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/api_server.py

curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "prisoner of war handling", "top_k": 3, "collection": "army", "hybrid": false}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("vector-only ok")'

userStories.title: Add collection='*' cross-collection search to /api/query
userStories.description:
Current state: /app/zk-rag-v2/api_server/api_server.py exists with POST /api/query supporting vector-only and hybrid for a single named collection.

What to add: Support collection='*' in POST /api/query.

Behaviour for collection='*':
1. Run the search (vector or hybrid) against all 6 collections
2. Collect all results, deduplicate by chunk_id
3. Merge all results into a single ranked list and return top_k

For the response: collection field should be '*'.

Do NOT modify the single-collection search behaviour. Do NOT add any new endpoints.
